flights.title: Crosswind 15 m/s
flights.story: Steady 15 m/s wind from the north with gusts, pushing on the booster's 71 m side.

flights.title: Late ignition
flights.story: The landing burn starts 200 m lower than planned: less room to brake.

baseline.reason: aborted (no-go at the gate); missed: lateral miss, too fast vertically, drifting sideways, tilted

flights.title: Overshoot
flights.story: The booster arrives 160 m further downrange than planned, already closer to the tower.

flights.title: Engine out at 5 s
flights.story: One of the three centre engines fails 5 s into the burn.

mpc.reason: aborted (no feasible trajectory); missed: lateral miss, too fast vertically, drifting sideways, tilted

baseline.reason: aborted (braking out of reach); missed: lateral miss, too fast vertically, drifting sideways, tilted

flights.title: Engine out at 10 s
flights.story: One of the three centre engines fails 10 s into the burn, inside the commit window.

mpc.reason: aborted (no-go at the gate); missed: too fast vertically, drifting sideways, tilted

baseline.reason: aborted (braking out of reach); missed: lateral miss, too fast vertically, drifting sideways, tilted
